notes.text: This is a handwritten working sheet. The visible pencil 35 at the lower left is recorded as archive numbering. No separate author page number, title, date, drawing or arrow diagram is visible. Six mathematical display groups are transcribed.

The opening continues a sentence about the cardinal of the set referred to as (18), then lists four Sigma terms. I read the reference directly as 18. The earlier-page suggestion recorded in the supplied context was not followed by inspecting any other page.

The writer replaces the crossed phrase beginning hypothèse with the interlinear définition, followed by des déc. binaires. The words non and vides carry separate underlines. Displays (*) and (**) have crossed equality signs.

The prose explicitly refers to diagramme (14). This page contains the reference but no drawing of that diagram. The two-row display (***) has a visible shared brace. Its a) comparison strokes are thickly overtraced; H’s editorial appeal to the following argument was recorded without using it to choose the final stroke state.

After (***) the writer says the two relations cannot be satisfied simultaneously and refers to (16) (c). These are reported as the manuscript’s argument and reference, with no proof check or replacement statement made in this reading.

The first index in the right-hand parentheses of (****) has extra dark material after 1. The second capital has crossed underlying strokes. Both visible layers are retained under uncertainty; the earlier left-hand terms were used for visual comparison only.

The following paragraph contains a long cancelled prose phrase, an interlinear replacement with the written abbreviation en = temps, a cancelled equation, an overwritten E candidate, and a crowded correction before qui contredit (3). The initial case of Car/car and several old letters remain unresolved. H’s note about partly crossed and rewritten lines was taken into account; its broad state note does not supply the missing replacement words.

The underlined heading Proposition precedes a capitalized Card and the four-element written set. The line has pas l’un directly. The three labels in the last display are a), a’), b); the first is overtraced, and the display label 20 overlays an uncertain older number.

The last line is physically cut by the lower sheet edge. Its uncertain word after cardinal, two subsequent marks, and final trois are retained as visible readings with uncertainty. The source gives no visible author doubt such as a question mark or verification instruction on this sheet.
No theorem was proved, no formal or computational mathematics was run, and no conditional replacement theorem or conjecture was introduced. The check_events list is therefore empty.

workflow_feedback.sequence: Read brief and supplied notation, packet and page-specific witnesses/conventions. Viewed the whole once for layout and each provided half once line by line. Listed the remaining open loci and made one enhanced crop per coherent locus or interacting passage. Viewed each crop once. Saved complete reading.tex before composing return.json.
workflow_feedback.crop_processing: Each crop was made from the original whole image, autocontrasted, resized to width 3000 using LANCZOS, and sharpened with UnsharpMask(radius=1.2, percent=150, threshold=3). No rotation was needed.
workflow_feedback.cropping_limits: All target strokes fit the recorded source bounds. The lower sheet physically cuts the final line in crop 11. Contextual fragments at the borders of other tight crops are not their target loci. No decided locus was cropped again; no enlarged half was reopened.
workflow_feedback.h_drawings: H.tex names no drawing for this page, and the source page contains no drawing or diagram. No unrelated H drawing file was read.
workflow_feedback.independence: No OCR, PDF text extraction, external research, compilation, other page image, other reader output or root decision was used. The supplied pre-scan036 notation table was read as authorized.
workflow_feedback.uncertainty_collation: Same-primary uncertainty alone is not counted against H. H editorial notes were read for their acknowledged revision state. The older numeral candidate below 20 is recorded as additional text, not as a new claim that H missed rewriting.
